test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84e58bc69ab1e1939b54d36f9952c7673777b1b1e53db73e888530b047c2a482.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **The cross is moving in anti-clockwise direction and it **skips a space** at alternate steps.**
 
• The division sign is moving in anti-clockwise direction and it skips a space at alternate steps.

​

The next step will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f96bc2c3de28a1e5bb38e084418c9ecc34714baf23a8186a8ad8a4f48e9c00f.png] 

Now we compare the pattern with the given options:

Option 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f26ed4ab8d3bcf7a83e7e71696f362986dca099152ece8144f0357050cc1087f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f7674a9ef0daa6c21eab450f460211fdfc470682dc29ba88e3f589a6d79c8c4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa60138a97c7b94dc89756e48712da44daab290248618cf0ca45b1f682148fa2.png] The pattern is incorrect in this option.

Option 2)
